_comment: WP6c budget file (issue #44, blocker B2). PLAN §2: 'budget is config,
not code'. Every pilot reads the two numeric caps; --pilot c ALSO
requires the FIVE authorization fields below to be filled in, and
refuses to spend a single session while any of them is missing,
still says PENDING, or is not the sentence/date it names (a number
signs nothing) — live_pilot.require_full_run_authorization.
The caps below are the WP6a defaults, so pilots a and b behave exactly
as they did before this file existed. Filling this file in is the
operator's decision (issue #44 B2: sessions per window, completion
deadline, abort rule) — it is deliberately NOT pre-authorised here.
Fields:
max_sessions_per_day  per-UTC-day session cap. Checklist item 12 and,
for pilot c, item 23 measure sessions per UTC
day against this number.
max_wall_per_session  outer wall bound per session, seconds (the
harness SIGKILLs the CLI at this bound).
calibrated_at         UTC timestamp of the measurement the cap comes
from (a stale cap is not a cap).
basis                 WHY the cap is that number: the measured
per-session wall (WP6a item 12 / WP6c item 10),
the quota evidence (`devin auth status`), and
the resulting sessions/day. WP0 §4: the CLI
exposes no remaining-quota field, so the cap is
an estimate and must say so.
authorized_by         who approved the run (issue #44 B1/B2).
completion_deadline   the date the run must finish by (WP6c plan: the
submission window closes 2026-09-06; B5 says
re-measure the date from the live leaderboard
page and record it here).
abort_rule            the condition under which the run stops without
a retry (issue #44 B7). Must be a sentence, not
a placeholder: the operator is the only one who
can decide what 'abnormal' costs.
calibrated_at: PENDING (issue #44 B2: date the measurement this cap rests on)
basis: PENDING (issue #44 B2: name the measured per-session wall and the quota evidence behind max_sessions_per_day)
authorized_by: PENDING (issue #44 B1/B2: who authorised the run and its cost)
completion_deadline: PENDING (issue #44 B2/B5: the date the 500-instance run must finish by)
abort_rule: PENDING (issue #44 B7: when does the run stop without a retry?)
